items.distractor_fact: ಅದೇ ದಿನ ಒಂದು ಮನೆಯ ಥರ್ಮಾಮೀಟರ್ {D}°C ತೋರಿಸಿತು.
items.gloss_en: That same day, a house's thermometer showed {D}°C.
items.entity_note: owner is a measuring instrument (a home thermometer), not a place as in the first distractor (a neighboring city)

items.distractor_fact: ಅದೇ ದಿನ ಒಂದು ಮ್ಯೂಚುಯಲ್ ಫಂಡ್ ಯುನಿಟ್‌ ಬೆಲೆ €{D} ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: That same day, a mutual fund unit's price was €{D}.
items.entity_note: owner is a financial instrument (a mutual fund unit), not another organisation as in the first distractor (a different company)

items.distractor_fact: ಅದೇ ಸಂಜೆ ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಒಂದು ನದಿ ಮಾಪನ ಕೇಂದ್ರ {D} m ಮಟ್ಟ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿತು.
items.gloss_en: That same evening, a river gauge station in this area recorded a level of {D} m.
items.entity_note: owner is a measuring instrument (a river gauge station), not a place as in the first distractor (a neighboring lake)

items.distractor_fact: ಒಬ್ಬ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತ ಇದೇ ತಿಂಗಳು €{D} ಠೇವಣಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
items.gloss_en: A friend deposited €{D} this same month.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a friend), not another financial account as in the first distractor (another savings account)

items.distractor_fact: ಒಬ್ಬ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ಬಳಿ ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ €{D} ನಗದು ಇತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: A friend had €{D} in cash at the start.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a friend) holding cash, not another card instrument as in the first distractor (another gift card)

items.distractor_fact: ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಹೋದ್ಯೋಗಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಇದೇ ತಿಂಗಳ ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ {D} GB ಡೇಟಾ ಇತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: A colleague had {D} GB of data at the start of this same month.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a colleague), not another data-plan instrument as in the first distractor (another data plan)

items.distractor_fact: ಒಂದು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಈ ತಿಂಗಳ ಆದಾಯ €{D} ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: An organisation's income this month was €{D}.
items.entity_note: owner is a business organisation, not another household (a family/person group) as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: ಬೇರೊಂದು ಟೂರ್ನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೇ ಋತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ತಂಡ {D} ಗೋಲ್ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
items.gloss_en: In another tournament this same season, a team scored {D} goals.
items.entity_note: owner is tied to a different series/competition (another tournament), not simply another team-organisation as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: ಒಬ್ಬ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಫ್ರೀಲ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್ ಇದೇ ತ್ರೈಮಾಸಿಕದಲ್ಲಿ €{D} ಲಾಭ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿದರು.
items.gloss_en: An independent freelancer recorded €{D} in gains this same quarter.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a freelancer), not another business organisation as in the first distractor (another small business)
